method.instrumentation: NODE_OPTIONS V8 --cpu-prof; no engine or frozen-harness instrumentation
method.phaseAttribution: Stack sampling; GC has no caller. Inclusive percentages overlap; self percentages partition worker samples. Whole worker profiles include module loading and scorer comparison outside official timed replay. CPU sampling is an estimate and includes profiler overhead.

segmentAwareTimingFit.model: ms = worker intercept + segment coefficient * segments + move coefficient * moves
segmentAwareTimingFit.limitation: Descriptive cross-session fit, not direct phase timing or causal startup measurement; different games/commands have different costs and profiling adds overhead.
